title: 第3739章 本祖是她的师尊第3738章 复仇而来的三人
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
第二天，无事发生。
苏凡几人待在茶花谷，享受着难得的清闲时光，顺便将升级版的弑神三剑和五行神典领悟。
而这种清闲的时光，过得总是很快，黄泉试炼终于开启。
翌日清晨！
一道洪亮的钟声，突然响彻在星辰殿上空，久久不散，所有人都在这一刻被惊醒。
也包括苏凡几人。
端木雪一袭白裙，如画中仙子，走到阁楼，银雪般的发丝随风轻舞，成为茶花谷最靓丽的一道风景。
“雪妹子，早啊！”
苏凡打着哈欠走出来。
“早。”
端木雪微笑着点头。
李有德几人也相继走出来。
端木雪看着几人：“你们有没有去购买神丹？”
几人摇头。
端木雪黛眉一蹙：“为什么不去？这可是黄泉试炼，我希望你们能严肃对待。”
“淡定淡定。”
李有德摆着手。
胖爷身怀柳家和四大王族的藏宝库，还怕没有神丹？
“懒得说你们。”
端木雪哼了口气。

这些混蛋，完全没把她说的话放在心上。
苏凡扫视着茶花谷：“雪妹子，陈老怎么还没回来？”
“不知道。”
端木雪摇头，抬头眺望了眼天边，眼中隐隐可见一丝忧虑：“先去名人堂吧！”
……
名人堂。
当端木雪和苏凡几人赶来的时候，所有的名人堂弟子都已经集结于高空。
总殿主夫妇和各大老祖也在。
“雪儿，我在这。”
江采薇站在人群前方，对着端木雪挥手。
端木雪笑了笑，带着苏凡几人朝江采薇走去。
围在前面的名人堂弟子，纷纷退到一旁，让开一条路，望着端木雪，眼中充满敬畏。
趴在苏凡肩上的小青龙，嗖地一下落在江采薇的肩上：“小妈，儿子想你了。”
这称呼一出，全场顿时一片死寂。
所有人，包括总殿主夫妇，几大老祖，纷纷盯着小青龙。
小妈？
content_en:
The next day, nothing happened.
Su Fan and others stayed in the Camellia Valley, enjoying the rare leisure time, and by the way, they understood the upgraded versions of the Three God-killing Swords and the Five Elements Divine Code.
And this kind of leisure time always passes quickly, and the trial of Huangquan finally begins.
The next morning!
A loud bell suddenly resounded over the Star Palace and lingered for a long time. Everyone was awakened at this moment.
Including Su Fan and others.
Duanmuxue was dressed in a white dress, looking like a fairy in a painting. When she walked to the attic, her silver snow-like hair danced in the wind, becoming the most beautiful scenery in the Camellia Valley.
"Sister Xue, morning!"
Su Fan came out yawning.
"Morning."
Duanmuxue smiled and nodded.
Li Youde and others also came out one after another.
Duanmuxue looked at the people: "Have you bought the magic pill?"
Several people shook their heads.
Duanmu Xuedai frowned: "Why don't you go? This is the trial of hell. I hope you can take it seriously."
"Calm down."
Li Youde waved his hands.
The fat man possesses the treasure troves of the Liu family and the four royal families, so he is afraid that he will not have the magic pill?
"Too lazy to talk to you."
Duanmuxue snorted.
These bastards didn't take what she said to heart at all.
Su Fan glanced at the Camellia Valley: "Sister Xue, why hasn't Mr. Chen come back yet?"
"I don't know."
Duanmuxue shook his head, raised his head and looked at the horizon, with a hint of worry in his eyes: "Let's go to the Hall of Fame first!"
…
Hall of Fame.
When Duanmuxue and Su Fan arrived, all the Hall of Fame disciples had already gathered high in the sky.
The main hall master, his wife and the major ancestors were also there.
"Xue'er, I'm here."
Jiang Caiwei stood in front of the crowd and waved to Duanmuxue.
Duanmuxue smiled and walked towards Jiang Caiwei with Su Fan and others.
The Hall of Fame disciples who were gathered in front stepped aside and made way for them, looking at Duanmuxue with awe in their eyes.
The little green dragon lying on Su Fan's shoulder suddenly landed on Jiang Caiwei's shoulder: "Mom, my son misses you."
As soon as this title came out, there was a sudden silence in the whole place.
Everyone, including the main hall master and his wife, and several ancestors, stared at Xiao Qinglong.
Little mom?
